name: XR CLOUD
summary:
Events that can be participated in regardless of region and across countries, and events that incorporate the "realism unique to VR" that cannot be achieved with streaming live broadcasts are being organized.
With this app as the entrance, you can find and participate in a wide variety of virtual events, from entertainment to official events, from small-scale to several thousand to tens of thousands of people, including conferences, exhibitions, parties, live performances, public viewings, and more.
